Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Text Based ATC i. Bidder should submit following mandatory documents:- a. Seal and signed Terms and Conditions. b. DGR Empanelment certificate. c. GST, Pan Card, EPF, ESIC. ii. This bid is reserved for DGR Sponsored Agencies only. Offer from other firm will be rejected, 100% ESM to be engaged by agency, in case of Non-availa bility of ex-serviceman. DGR guideline shall be followed. iii. Estimated case value has been considered as per DGR notice of Revision fo r minimum wages for one-day w.e.f 01/10/2026 for area B issued by DGR- MoD Government of India, New Delhi. iv. Tender enquiry for the subject case is hiring of 73 PSGs i.e. (1) 70 PSGs mal e + (2) 03 nos of Highly Skilled Supervisor for the period of one year. v. EMD clause- As per DGR guideline issued by MoD vide no. 28(75)/2020-D( Res) dated 13/05/2021 point no 11 (d) DGR sponsored ESM are not required to submit EMD. vi. PSD is applicable which is 10% of one-month wage bill in favour of Munition s India Limited O. F. Khamaria. vii. Price Variation clause is applicable. “In case of any changes in the minimum wages during the Contract period as notified by DGR, Buyer shall pay the S ervice Provider the difference in wages from the amount mentioned in the c ontract on pro-rata basis”. viii. Service provider have to follow recently implemented four labour codes st effective from 21 Nov. 2025. ix. Service provider shall paid @5% uniform outfit allowance to all PSGs/Super visor and should submit documentary proof of payment made either a copy of pass book of all PSGs/Supervisor or his own bank statement duly seal sig ned by the bank manager of the provider bank. x. Since, procurement through GeM, the Service Commission for Service Provi der is fixed at 11.21%, inclusive of all applicable taxes. The system will not accept any offered service commission that is higher or lower than the fixe d rate. Service Providers also cannot quote apart from any value other than 11.21% while bid participation. xi. In case of DGR sponsored Agencies quoting the same rates, the principal e mployer will award the contract to the senior most sponsored Agency as pe r DGR sponsorship Guidelines. xii. As per MIL directives vide Lt. No. MIL/HR/2024-25 Dt. 13/08/2024, clause “N ear- relationship certificate that none of his/her relative is working in the Un it where he/she is going to bid for the tender. The near relative for this purp ose should be well define in the tender’’ may be incorporated in this tender. “The Bidder/Tender shall disclose whether any relative of the bidder /tender er, it proprietor, partner director or person having a controlling or material i nterest in the firm is employed with or associated with the procuring entity. Near relative shall mean a person related by blood, marriage or legal

relationship, including spouse, father, mother, son, daughter, brother, sister and such other relatives as may be specified under the applicable rules of t he procuring entity. The Bidder/Tenderer shall submit a declaration confor ming above. Any non-disclosure or incorrect declaration may be dealt with i n accordance with the applicable tender conditions and rules of procuring e ntity”. st xiii. Principal employer will pay basic wages due to the security agency by 1 o f every month. Payment including all allowances to all security guard/super visor will be done only by ECS/other mode of electronic fund transfer like N EFT, RTGS, IMPS etc in his/her pension account with the bank by the securit th y agency by 7 of each month as per payment wages act. xiv. Since, case value is more than Rs. 5 crore (incl. OC) hence, bidder have to s ubmit sealed & signed pre integrity pact. xv. Further it is also advised that PSD may be submitted through online payme nt mode after award of contract on GeM Portal in favor CGM, beneficiary det ails as given below, and also Indemnity Bonds may be accepted as perform ance security deposit from central/State PSUs. If seller submit the PSD thro ugh online payment mode, then seller shall upload the documentary proof of online payment of PSD at GeM Portal. Account Name : Munitions India Limited O F Khamaria Account No. : 40436892598 IFSC : SBIN0003228 MICR : 482002006 Bank address : STATE BANK OF INDIA, RANJHI Performance Security Deposit (PSD) is to be furnished by the successful bidde r within 30 days after placement of contract. If the firm fails to submit the PSD within the specified date, it shall be treated as an unreliable firm and shall be governed as per existing guidelines on penalties issued by MoD/MIL/GeM. xvi. In case of any clarification bidder can enquire through e-mail i.e. ofkpvgrp8 @ord.gov.in OR call at 0761-2742137.Other terms and conditions as pe r uploaded ‘TERMS AND CONDITIONS’. xvii.
